analysis.summary: 分析了 19 个 60 秒窗口；最高压力模型分数为 0.999，对应窗口 2（从 0 编号）。该分数不表示临床患病概率或医学诊断；局部贡献描述模型行为，不证明压力反应的原因。

limitations: Trained on laboratory stress recordings (WESAD); no clinical validation.
Maximum window score is not a session probability.
Chest-derived signals only; wrist signals are not modeled in this version.
Trained on laboratory stress recordings (WESAD); outputs are not clinical diagnoses or disease probabilities.
Session score is the maximum window score and increases exposure to isolated extreme windows.
Feature associations do not establish causal explanations of an individual's physiology.
Reference deviations use baseline-class training windows with a standard-deviation floor of 1e-6.
Local contributions are signed raw-margin units, not probability changes.

publication.uncertainty: 该模型是基于实验室数据（WESAD）训练的非临床压力模式分类器，未经临床验证；分数和特征贡献不能证明病因或患病概率，也不能用于诊疗。
recommendations: 请先核对输入协议、数据完整性和采集质量，再复测分析；压力模型高分不能作为诊疗依据。
